subject.title: Discord plugin does not auto-reconnect after 1006 WS close (forces full gateway restart, kills in-flight turns)

question: Is the latest-release live evidence plus the closed abnormal-close PR proof enough to sponsor an instrumented close-handler mitigation, or should maintainers first require a current-main public-path reproduction that identifies the lifecycle transition suppressing reconnect?
rationale: The issue is high-impact and credible, but the prior focused PR was paused because its tests manufactured the stale reconnect state rather than reaching it through a public production path.

options.title: Require Current-Main Transition Proof
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask for live or harness proof that reaches the stale disabled-reconnect state through a public gateway lifecycle path before accepting a code fix.

options.title: Sponsor A Bounded Mitigation
options.body: A Discord owner can accept a close-handler mitigation with promoted operational diagnostics and regression coverage while using future logs to identify the hidden transition.

options.title: Split Operator Fallback
options.body: Treat automatic reconnect as the primary bug and separately track any channel-scoped reconnect command if maintainers want an interim recovery surface.

recommendation.title: Require Current-Main Transition Proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and ask for live or harness proof that reaches the stale disabled-reconnect state through a public gateway lifecycle path before accepting a code fix.

likelyOwner.reason: This account provided the relevant maintainer review on the closest abnormal-close reconnect PR and is connected to adjacent Discord gateway history.
